title: 30% app cap proposed; WhatsApp Pay approved
detail: NPCI proposed a 30% volume cap on third-party apps and approved a limited WhatsApp Pay rollout.

title: B2C and B2B credited to the PSP bank
detail: Definition change in NPCI's app table. Bank-app volumes (for example Axis Bank, 5 mn to 92 mn) are not comparable before and after.

title: Navi starts UPI payments
detail: First appears in NPCI data in September 2023; passes Amazon Pay in August 2024 and Axis Bank in September 2024.

title: RBI restricts Paytm Payments Bank
detail: Announced 31 January; deadline moved to 15 March. Paytm's share falls from 11.9% (Jan) to 8.2% (May 2024).

title: super.money (Flipkart) launches in beta
detail: Open to all Android users in August 2024. Plateaus near 1.3% share through late 2025.

title: Cap deadline moved to Dec 2026; WhatsApp limit removed
detail: NPCI extended the 30% cap compliance date to 31 December 2026 and lifted WhatsApp's onboarding limit on 31 December. No significant WhatsApp step in the data.

title: RBI cancels Paytm Payments Bank licence
detail: Effective 24 April 2026 under the Banking Regulation Act. Paytm says its UPI service continues.

title: 0.4% merchant fee on UPI payments above Rs 2,000
detail: Effective 15 October 2026, capped at Rs 300, paid by the merchant; P2P and small merchants exempt. Reported by many outlets; the primary circular was not seen. Too early to see in the data.
